## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, and none was weakened or removed to pass
- [ ] `npm run validate` was run and its result is reported above
- [ ] Documentation was updated in this change (or a waiver reason is given)
- [ ] An ADR was added for architecture-level decisions (or `ADR: not-required: <reason>` is in a commit)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated for `feat`, `fix`, `security` and `perf` changes
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or debug leftovers are included
- [ ] Changes to guardrail files have explicit human approval

See `governance/CHANGE_MANAGEMENT.md` for the full change lifecycle.
